verdict.rationale: Letta clearly supports running fully locally without cloud dependency: the CLI's default local mode stores agent state on-device without a Letta login (letta-docs-31), the self-hosted App Server can run 'entirely on infrastructure you control' (letta-docs-30, letta-docs-38), and a runtime probe confirms both the CLI and `letta server` boot keylessly with local WebSocket endpoints and on-device state (letta-probe-rt-1, letta-probe-rt-2). However, the story also asks about embedding the memory layer in-process or against local models, and the evidence pack never documents in-process/embedded usage (Letta's architecture is CLI/SDK-to-server) nor explicit support for local LLM backends (e.g. Ollama) — the only model-serving mention is an OpenAI-compatible API on the App Server, not local model inference. Missing for 10: evidence of true in-process/embedded operation, and evidence of running against local (non-cloud) LLM providers rather than just a self-hosted server exposing an API.
